title: Assets approval permission is refused to the storekeeper
description: SECURITY. The storekeeper may hold AssetsRead and AssetsPost through the tenant grant, but never AssetsApprove. The read-only approval-access probe therefore refuses the storekeeper with 403 and answers the tenant administrator with can_approve true. The ExUnit route test assets_approve_tasks_test.exs proves the same permission guard on every real packed post, reverse and approve task. These runner steps write nothing, so there is nothing to clean up.
